# NewsRoomIN

> > International news aggregator covering global politics, geopolitics, economics, and culture across multiple languages with focus on EU, US, Russia, and Iran affairs.

NewsRoomIN is a multilingual news portal delivering breaking international news and in-depth analysis across English, Russian, and Lithuanian editions. The platform aggregates coverage of major geopolitical events, EU policy developments, economic trends, and cultural stories with emphasis on Eastern European and Middle Eastern affairs.

## Key Topics

- International News
- Geopolitics
- European Union
- Breaking News
- Politics
- Economics
- Business
- European Affairs
- Global Events
- Iran-Israel Conflict
- US Foreign Policy
- Russia
- Culture
- Technology
- News Aggregation

## Core News Portals

- [Top Stories - NewsRoomIN English](https://newsroomin.eu/en): Top stories in English covering international news, politics, geopolitics, and breaking news
- [Статьи - NEWSROOM](https://newsroomin.eu): NEWSROOM homepage with international news coverage across politics, business, culture, technology
- [Straipsniai - NewsRoomIN Lithuania](https://newsroomin.eu/lt): Lithuanian language news portal with international and local coverage
- [ВСЕХ ПУБЛИКАЦИИ - NEWSROOM](https://newsroomin.eu/all-posts): Complete news digest archive featuring international politics, economics, business, and society
